nodes.summary: The allelic partition of a set partition of `Fin n`: the multiset of its block sizes, a partition of the integer `n`.
nodes.title: Allelic partition of a set partition

nodes.summary: Removing the last customer undoes every seating: restricting `seat π c` to the first `n` customers gives back `π`.
nodes.title: Removing the last customer undoes a seating

nodes.summary: Law of the Chinese restaurant process (Pitman 2006, §3.1): `P(π) = θ^{|π|} ∏_{B ∈ π} (|B| - 1)! / θ^{(n)}`.
nodes.title: Law of the Chinese restaurant process

nodes.summary: Exchangeability, pointwise: relabeling the customers by a permutation `σ` does not change the probability of a partition.
nodes.title: Exchangeability

nodes.summary: The law of the multiset of block sizes after `n` customers is the law `Ewens.hoppeLaw` of Hoppe's urn on allelic partitions after `n` draws.
nodes.title: The block sizes follow Hoppe's urn

nodes.summary: The allelic partition of the Chinese restaurant process follows the Ewens sampling formula (Ewens 1972; Hoppe 1984): the multiset of block sizes after `n` customers has law `Ewens.ewensProb θ`.
nodes.title: The allelic partition of the Chinese restaurant process follows the Ewens sampling formula

nodes.summary: Exchangeability of the Chinese restaurant process (Aldous 1985, §11): the law of the partition relabeled by any permutation of the customers is the law of the partition.
nodes.title: Exchangeability of the Chinese restaurant process

nodes.summary: Restricting the random partition of `Fin n` to the first `m ≤ n` customers gives the process with `m` customers.
nodes.title: Consistency for every sample size

nodes.summary: Restricting the random partition of `Fin (n + 1)` to the first `n` customers gives the process with `n` customers.
nodes.title: Consistency of the Chinese restaurant process

nodes.summary: One seating multiplies the closed-form law by the seating probability.
nodes.title: Seating multiplies the closed-form law by the seating probability

nodes.summary: The closed-form law of the Chinese restaurant process, `θ^{|π|} ∏_{B ∈ π} (|B| - 1)! / θ^{(n)}` (Pitman 2006, §3.1). Every block is nonempty, so `|B| - 1` is never a truncated natural subtraction.
nodes.title: Closed-form law of the Chinese restaurant process

nodes.summary: One step of the Chinese restaurant process: the law of the partition of `Fin (n + 1)` given the partition `π` of the first `n` customers.
nodes.title: One step of the Chinese restaurant process

nodes.summary: The law of the Chinese restaurant process as a real number.
nodes.title: Chinese restaurant process law as a real number

nodes.summary: The Chinese restaurant process with parameter `θ > 0`: the law of the random partition of the customers `Fin n` into tables, built one customer at a time by `crpStep` (Aldous 1985, §11; Pitman 2006, ch. 3).
nodes.title: Chinese restaurant process

nodes.summary: The Ewens sampling formula is nonnegative for `θ > 0`; with `sum_ewensProb` it is a probability distribution on the partitions of `n`.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the Ewens sampling formula

nodes.summary: The Ewens sampling formula: the probability, under the neutral infinite-alleles model with scaled mutation rate `θ = 4Nu`, that a sample of `n` genes has allelic partition `π` (`π.parts.count j` alleles carried by exactly `j` genes each): `n! * (∏ j, (θ / j) ^ (a j) / (a j)!) / θ^{(n)}` (Ewens 1972), for `θ > 0`.
nodes.title: Ewens sampling formula

nodes.summary: Every partition of `Fin (n + 1)` arises by seating customer `n` into its restriction to the first `n` customers.
nodes.title: Every partition arises from seating the last customer

nodes.summary: Hoppe's urn generates the Ewens sampling formula (Hoppe 1984): after `n` draws, the allelic partition has law `ewensProb θ`.
nodes.title: Hoppe's urn generates the Ewens sampling formula

nodes.summary: The law of Hoppe's urn after `n` draws is nonnegative for `θ > 0`.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the Hoppe urn law

nodes.summary: The law of the allelic partition after `n` draws from Hoppe's urn, started from the empty sample: `hoppeLaw θ (n + 1) π' = ∑ π, hoppeLaw θ n π * hoppeStep θ π π'`.
nodes.title: Law of the allelic partition from Hoppe's urn

nodes.summary: Hoppe-urn transition probabilities are nonnegative.
nodes.title: Hoppe urn transition probabilities are nonnegative

nodes.summary: One step of Hoppe's urn on allelic partitions (Hoppe 1984): from a partition `π` of `k`, the next gene carries a new allele with probability `θ / (θ + k)` (target parts `1 ::ₘ π.parts`), and copies an allele carried by `j` genes with probability `j * a j / (θ + k)`, where `a j = π.parts.count j` (target parts `(j + 1) ::ₘ π.parts.erase j`). The value is the transition probability from `π` to `π'`.
nodes.title: One step of Hoppe's urn

nodes.summary: Seat customer `n` at the occupied table `B` of `π`: the block `B` becomes `B ∪ {n}` and the other blocks are unchanged.
nodes.title: Seating a customer at an occupied table

nodes.summary: Seat customer `n` at a new table: the partition of `Fin (n + 1)` whose blocks are the blocks of `π` (relabeled into `Fin (n + 1)`) together with the singleton `{n}`.
nodes.title: Seating a customer at a new table

nodes.summary: The blocks of `joinTable π B hB`.
nodes.title: Blocks of the partition after joining a table

nodes.summary: The blocks of `newTable π`.
nodes.title: Blocks of the partition after opening a new table

nodes.summary: The seating choice of customer `n`, as a probability distribution.
nodes.title: Seating choice distribution of a customer

nodes.summary: Different seating choices give different partitions.
nodes.title: Injectivity of seating

nodes.summary: The seating probabilities are nonnegative for `θ > 0`.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of seating probabilities

nodes.summary: The probability of each seating choice for customer `n` given the partition `π` of the first `n` customers: `θ / (n + θ)` for a new table, `|B| / (n + θ)` for the table `B`.
nodes.title: Seating probabilities in the Chinese restaurant process

nodes.summary: Seat customer `n` according to the choice `c`: `none` opens a new table, `some B` joins the occupied table `B`.
nodes.title: Seating a customer by a seating choice

nodes.summary: Expected number of tables (expected number of alleles in a sample of `n` genes, Ewens 1972): `E[|π|] = ∑_{i < n} θ / (θ + i)`.
nodes.title: Expected number of tables

nodes.summary: Expected number of alleles in a sample of `n` genes under the Ewens sampling formula: `E[K_n] = ∑_{i < n} θ / (θ + i)` (Ewens 1972).
nodes.title: Expected number of alleles

nodes.summary: The Ewens sampling formula is a probability distribution on the partitions of `n` (Ewens 1972; equivalently, Cauchy's cycle-type formula `∑_{σ ∈ S_n} θ^{#cycles σ} = θ^{(n)}`).
nodes.title: The Ewens sampling formula is a probability distribution

nodes.summary: The Hoppe-urn transition is stochastic: from every partition of `k` the probabilities of the partitions of `k + 1` sum to one.
nodes.title: Hoppe urn transition is stochastic

nodes.summary: The seating probabilities sum to one for `θ > 0`.
nodes.title: Seating probabilities sum to one
